title: I-Kyber iqoqa ama-$5M ukuze yakhe ingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela yobuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
EParis / eSan Francisco, zi-10 kuJuni 2026. I-Kyber iyaphuma obala ngemuva kokusebenza ngasese, iphethe uxhaso lokuqalisa lwamadola ayizigidi ezi-5, oluholwa yi-Lightspeed Venture Partners, kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwe-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures. Yasungulwa nguJean-Baptiste Kempf, unjiniyela ongemuva kwe-VLC Media Player ne-FFmpeg. I-Kyber yakha ingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela enomthombo ovulekile exhumanisa abantu nabenzeli bobuhlakani bokwenziwa namarobhothi, amadrowuni nezinhlelo ezizisebenzelayo, kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yomhlaba, cishe ngaphandle kokubambezeleka.

Ungqimba olungabonakali obekade lusweleka ebuhlakanini bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela

Kukhona uhlobo lobuchwepheshe abantu abaningi abangakaze bacabange ngalo. Alunaso isixhumi-bonakalo. Lumane lusebenze buthule, kuze kufike usuku lapho seluyisisekelo esingenakwenzeka lutho ngaphandle kwalo emhlabeni.

UJean-Baptiste Kempf useneminyaka engamashumi amabili akha lolo hlobo kanye lobuchwepheshe. Kuqala kwaba yi-VLC, isidlali semidiya esifakwe buthule ezisetshenzisweni eziyizigidigidi ezine. Kwalandela i-FFmpeg, umtapo wamakhodekhi osebenza cishe kuyo yonke inkundla yevidiyo emhlabeni. Kokubili kwaba yizingxenye ezibalulekile nezingabonakali zengqalasizinda ye-inthanethi.

I-Kyber yakhelwe phezu kwaleyo nkolelo efanayo, kodwa manje isiyisetshenziswa emkhawulweni omusha: umhlaba wangempela.

Njengoba ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buphuma ezikrinini bungena emarobhothini, emadrowunini, ezinhlelweni zokuhlinza nasezimotweni ezizishayelayo, inselele eyodwa iba yinto ethinta wonke umuntu: ukusebenzisana ngesikhathi sangempela. Irobhothi alinakho ukulinda ngenkathi kulayishwa. Idrowuni ayikwazi ukubambezeleka. Umshini olawulwa ukude kufanele usabele ngokushesha kwangathi umi phambi kwakho.

Kuze kube manje, ingqalasizinda yokwenza lokho kube ngokwenzeka yayingekho nhlobo.

Kungani ukubambezeleka kuyinkinga enkulu, nokuthi i-Kyber iyixazulula kanjani

Iningi lezinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela namuhla lakhelwe phezu kwe-WebRTC, iphrothokholi eyaklanyelwa izingcingo zevidiyo. Uma ukubambezeleka kungama-200 ms, imoto elawulwa ukude isihambe amamitha ambalwa idlula lapho umshayeli ebehlose ukuyimisa khona. Kuma-8 ms, okuyilokho i-Kyber ekwenza kube ngokwenzeka, umshini uzwakala sengathi uyingxenye yomzimba womshayeli uqobo.

I-Kyber inikeza i-SDK eyodwa evumelanisa konke okudingekayo ukuze kulawulwe imishini ngesikhathi sangempela:

  • Ividiyo, umsindo, idatha yezinzwa nemiyalo yokulawula, konke kuvumelaniswe newashi elilodwa
  • Ukubambezeleka kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni okungehla kufike kuma-8 ms, ngaphansi komkhawulo ongezwiwa umuntu
  • Inomthombo ovulekile emnyombweni wayo, ingafakwa ezakhiweni zenkampani, efwini noma ezindaweni ezixubile

Yakhelwe amarobhothi, i-XR, amadrowuni, izimoto ezizishayelayo, abenzeli bobuhlakani bokwenziwa, ukulawula ikhompyutha ukude, kanye nesizukulwane esilandelayo sezinhlelo zobuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela.

Isivele isetshenziswa kwezohwebo ngabadlali abahamba phambili emkhakheni wezokuvikela, wezokuxhumana ngocingo, wamarobhothi nowobuhlakani bokwenziwa, i-Kyber iyithimba labantu abangama-26 abangonjiniyela abangochwepheshe, abavela emikhakheni yamarobhothi, yamanethiwekhi, yokucubungula okunokubambezeleka okuncane kanye nengqalasizinda yevidiyo.

Abatshalizimali abasekela umbono we-Kyber

Umzuliswano wokuqalisa wama-$5M uholwe yi-Lightspeed Venture Partners, enye yezinkampani ezihamba phambili emhlabeni ekutshaleni imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa, kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwe-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures.

“Njengoba besitshala imali emkhakheni wobuhlakani bokwenziwa nowamarobhothi, besilokhu sibona iphethini efanayo: amamodeli ebehlakanipha kakhulu, kodwa ingqalasizinda ewaxhumanisa nomhlaba wangempela ibingahambisani nalokho. Lokho kwasenza sambe ujule ezingqimbeni zobuchwepheshe, sizibuza ukuthi yini ngempela ebisweleka. I-Kyber ingenye yezimpendulo ezinamandla kakhulu esazithola kuleyo nkinga.” U-Antoine Moyroud, uMlingani e-Lightspeed Venture Partners

Okulandelayo

Lolu xhaso luzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa yi-Kyber kongqimba lwephrothokholi oluxhumanisa abantu nabenzeli bobuhlakani bokwenziwa nemishini ngesikhathi sangempela, kuyo yonke imikhakha lapho izinhlelo ezizisebenzelayo seziba ezibalulekile.

Njengoba esho uJean-Baptiste Kempf:

“Eminyakeni ezayo, kuzoba nemishini eminingi ezisebenzelayo ezulazula yonke indawo, futhi i-Kyber izokhiqiza isofthiwe eyinhloko yokwakha, ukulawula nokuqapha leyo mishini ngesikhathi sangempela.”

Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela buthuthuka ngesivinini. Imishini iya ihlakanipha. Manje ingqalasizinda kumele ihambisane nayo.

Funda kabanzi ku-kyber.tech

Mayelana ne-Kyber

Yasungulwa eParis nguJean-Baptiste Kempf, unjiniyela ongemuva kwe-VLC ne-FFmpeg, i-Kyber yakha ungqimba lwengqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela enomthombo ovulekile yobuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wangempela. Isekelwa yi-Lightspeed Venture Partners, i-Ovni Capital ne-Kima Ventures.

Mayelana ne-Lightspeed Venture Partners

I-Lightspeed iyinkampani yomhlaba wonke yokutshala imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa ezigabeni ezahlukene, ephethe izimpahla ezibalelwa ngaphezu kwama-$50B. Kusukela ngo-2000, i-Lightspeed isisekele ezinye zezinkampani ezinobuciko obusha kakhulu emhlabeni, okuhlanganisa i-Anthropic, i-Mistral, i-Snap, i-Wiz nezinye.

Iwebhusayithi: lightspeedhq.com

Mayelana ne-Ovni Capital

I-Ovni Capital iyinkampani yaseFrance yokutshala imali ezinkampanini ezisafufusa esekela osomabhizinisi abakha isizukulwane esilandelayo sobuchwepheshe obusemqoka, kusukela kobuchwepheshe obujulile kuya engqalasizindeni.

Iwebhusayithi: ovni.capital

Mayelana ne-Kima Ventures

Yasungulwa nguXavier Niel, i-Kima Ventures ingomunye wabatshalizimali basezigabeni zokuqala abasebenza kakhulu eYurophu, esekela abasunguli bezobuchwepheshe abanezifiso ezinkulu kusukela ezigabeni zokuqala ngqa.

Iwebhusayithi: https://www.kimaventures.com

Mayelana ne-Les Echos

I-Les Echos iyiphephandaba lansuku zonke elihamba phambili eFrance kwezamabhizinisi nezezimali, elibika izindaba zakamuva ngezomnotho, ezobuchwepheshe nezinto ezintsha.

Iwebhusayithi: lesechos.fr
